question: The Jivitputrika festival, which was in the news for an incident in September 2024, is primarily celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Jivitputrika festival**, also known as Jitiya Vrat, is celebrated in the** state of Bihar.**
 
• The **Jivitputrika festival is a three-day Hindu festival **that focuses on the well-being of children.
 
• It is **celebrated during the seventh to ninth lunar days **of Krishna-Paksha in the month of Ashwin.
 
• The f**estival is rooted in Hindu mythology, particularly the story of King Jimutavahana. **
